footer.text: This email was sent by Chat3D. If you did not expect this email, you can safely ignore it.

waitlistConfirmation.subject: Confirm your waitlist request
waitlistConfirmation.textBody: Please confirm your waitlist request by opening: {{confirmationUrl}}
waitlistConfirmation.heading: Confirm Your Waitlist Request
waitlistConfirmation.body: Please confirm your email address to complete your waitlist registration for Chat3D.

waitlistApproved.subject: Registration link for Chat3D
waitlistApproved.textBody: Your waitlist entry was approved. Register here: {{registrationUrl}}
waitlistApproved.heading: You're Approved!
waitlistApproved.body: Your waitlist entry has been approved. Click the button below to complete your registration.

emailConfirmation.subject: Confirm your email address
emailConfirmation.textBody:
Confirm your email address by opening: {{confirmUrl}}

This link expires in 24 hours.
emailConfirmation.heading: Confirm Your Email
emailConfirmation.body: Please confirm your email address to activate your Chat3D account.

forgotPassword.subject: Reset your password
forgotPassword.textBody:
Reset your password by opening: {{resetUrl}}

This link expires in 1 hour. If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.
forgotPassword.heading: Reset Your Password
forgotPassword.body: You requested a password reset for your Chat3D account. Click below to set a new password.
forgotPassword.expiry: This link expires in 1 hour. If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.

passwordResetConfirm.subject: Confirm your password reset
passwordResetConfirm.heading: Confirm Password Reset
passwordResetConfirm.body: You requested a password change for your Chat3D account. Click below to confirm.

emailChangeConfirm.subject: Confirm your email change
emailChangeConfirm.textBody: Confirm your new email address by opening: {{confirmationUrl}}
emailChangeConfirm.heading: Confirm Email Change
emailChangeConfirm.body: You requested to change your email address for your Chat3D account. Click below to confirm your new email.

dataExportConfirm.subject: Confirm your data export
dataExportConfirm.heading: Confirm Data Export
dataExportConfirm.body: You requested a data export from your Chat3D account. Click below to confirm.

accountDeleteConfirm.subject: Confirm your account deletion
accountDeleteConfirm.textBody: Confirm account deletion. Your account will be deactivated for 30 days: {{confirmationUrl}}
accountDeleteConfirm.heading: Confirm Account Deletion
accountDeleteConfirm.body: You requested to delete your Chat3D account. Your account will be deactivated for 30 days before permanent deletion. Click below to confirm.

accountReactivateConfirm.subject: Confirm your account reactivation
accountReactivateConfirm.heading: Confirm Account Reactivation
accountReactivateConfirm.body: You requested to reactivate your Chat3D account. Click below to confirm.

invitationDirect.subject: You are invited to Chat3D
invitationDirect.textBody: You were invited to Chat3D. Complete registration here: {{registerUrl}}
invitationDirect.heading: You're Invited!
invitationDirect.body: You've been invited to join Chat3D, an AI-powered 3D CAD modeling application. Click below to create your account.

invitationWaitlisted.subject: You were invited to Chat3D (waitlist)
invitationWaitlisted.textBody: You were invited to Chat3D and added to the waitlist. We will email you once approved.
invitationWaitlisted.heading: You're on the Waitlist
invitationWaitlisted.body: You've been invited to Chat3D and added to our waitlist. We'll send you a registration link once your spot is approved.

adminPasswordReset.subject: Password reset requested by admin
adminPasswordReset.textBody: An administrator requested a password reset for your account. Use this link to continue: {{resetUrl}}
adminPasswordReset.heading: Admin Password Reset
adminPasswordReset.body: An administrator has requested a password reset for your Chat3D account. Click below to set a new password.
